name: Garlic prawns with baby marrow noodles
summary: Prawns seared in olive oil with garlic, chilli and lemon, tossed through baby marrow noodles and cherry tomatoes and on the table in 25 minutes.
about: Cutting baby marrow into long strands and tossing it like spaghetti puts a whole plate of vegetables into a quick supper. Prawns and baby marrow both need only minutes in the pan, so the whole dish is cooked in about ten.

ingredients.name: Raw prawns
ingredients.note: peeled and deveined, thawed if frozen

ingredients.name: Baby marrows
ingredients.note: spiralised or cut into ribbons with a peeler

steps: Pat the prawns dry with paper towel and season with half the salt and all the pepper.

Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in your largest frying pan over high heat until it shimmers. Add half the prawns in one layer and sear for 1 minute a side, until pink and curled into a loose C. Lift onto a plate and repeat with another 1 tbsp of oil and the rest of the prawns.
Turn the heat to medium, add the last tablespoon of oil with the garlic and chilli flakes and stir for 1 minute, until the garlic is pale gold. Do not let it brown.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes, until they start to soften and give up their juice.
Add the baby marrow and the rest of the salt and toss with tongs for 2 minutes, until just warmed through but still with some bite; any more and the strands release water and flop.
Return the prawns and their juices to the pan with the lemon zest, lemon juice and parsley. Toss for 30 seconds and serve straight from the pan.
